Name: T's Farm Standard
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Adds [b]T's Farm Standard[/b] as a new farm type.

[b]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core[/url] 2.0.5 or later.[/b]

You can also choose to replace the vanilla Standard Farm through the GMCM settings.
The basic farm map size remains the same, with more usable space.
A hot spring is located in the upper-left corner of the farm, where you can refill your watering can.
If you prefer a more challenging experience, you can block access to the hot spring through the GMCM settings.
